exceptions.name: assertOmpNativeCacheComplete - accepts a matching payload and names every mismatch
exceptions.reason: Deno emitted the `t.step` container as its own passing test case; in bun:test that container is a `describe` suite that only registers the 13 step tests, which run as separate cases under the same name (`<parent> > <step>`). Bun has no case for a bare suite, and an empty `test(parent)` would be a fake pass.
